edge.listenerObservation: No :8080 listener was visible in the read-only ss observation; Docker API was inaccessible in the sandbox; no systemd unit containing 8080 was found by static scan.
edge.nginxSyntaxObservation: nginx -t reported syntax ok but could not open /run/nginx.pid because the sandbox filesystem is read-only; runtime validity is therefore unproven.

findings.detail: Two enabled public TLS payment domains wildcard-proxy to loopback :8080 without a mapped systemd/container owner or payment-truth authority.

Static config names certificates and proxying, but listener reachability and active upstream could not be established read-only; one domain config has Certbot-managed comments while the other has separate certificate references.

location / forwards every path and method to the unknown upstream; no route allowlist, authentication boundary, rate limit, maintenance freeze, or explicit payment contract is present in these server blocks.
No release identity, owner, health/version probe, rollback target, or audit record binds the public aliases to a reviewed artifact.
Two separate enabled configs and certificate paths create independent DNS/TLS/renewal and ownership drift; no single canonical payment edge manifest was found.

knownBlockers: production key registry/trusted time/revocation/replay controls not established
interpretation: This is a read-only inventory and rejection of acceptance. It grants no payment, customer, provider, network, deployment, restart, or production authority. E0.3 remains first unmet and BLOCKED_OWNER; E0.4 remains non-production IN_PROGRESS.
